# Vendored llm-dojo-scoring

Authoritative source: https://github.com/Exios66/llm-dojo-scoring

- Source ref: `v0.30.1` (tag on the `v0.30.0` release branch head after llm-dojo-scoring #169)
- Exact source commit: `116da0b0f5104165244ec9a4b7f068c1cf0048cf`
- Source package version: `0.30.0` in `pyproject.toml` (the `v0.30.1` tag did not bump it; the snapshot is identified by the tag and commit)
- Snapshot layout: llm_dojo_scoring/ relocated under src/ with the same shared exclusions.
- Generated by the SHA-verified standalone refresh (`sandbox fetch-deps`), 2026-11-17 UTC.
  File contents, paths and executable modes come from the reviewed commit.

Dojo `v0.30.1`, the commit llm-mailroom `63f6841` declares. Against `13adc8e`: #165/#166 type
correspondence `communication_type` by content, not carrier (`production_prompts` adds the
`correspondence_specialist_v8` candidate row; the `production` row and its digest are
unchanged); #168/#169 a typed judge or arbiter decision whose class the attempt never extracted
is counted under `no_gold`, never graded by an untyped score. **Score changes:** `decision.*`
lane scores can move on unchanged records. Extraction field scores are unchanged.

Previous pin: `13adc8ec722f0d635466062b6dda181958d4d5f8`, the Dojo `v0.30.0` branch head at the llm-dojo-scoring #163 merge, which fixes the Dojo issues
found under local-mailroom-sandbox #300: #162 month-first dates (`August 18`, `August 18th`)
now match inside longer text; #161 retired classes raise `KeyError` in `score_archive_block`
without an explicit field map; #160 Wilson bounds round outward (`wilson_ci(0, 379)` `hi`
0.0101, not 0.01), decision-lane gold respects attempt class and the resolved human class,
MAUD `calibration_error` is recomputed after the question rescore, and distinct off-vocabulary
`Type of Consideration` answers no longer tie; #159 llm-mailroom `RunRecord.gold` feeds the
review tray and lane scorers. **Score changes** against `542a1c3`: date fields, MAUD question
micro-accuracy, `ml.intake.selective_risk_upper`, `decision.*` and Wilson display bounds can
move on unchanged predictions (a sixth `0.30.0` score-changelog entry, `rescore_required`).
No public names change. Runs scored on `542a1c3` are not directly comparable with this pin.

Previous pin: `542a1c3e61cdb29a0e31b4ae1a2c2d8d42aff8e2`, the Dojo `v0.30.0` branch head, a fast-forward of `main` `f95c318` (110 commits): the 0.30.0 cut
(`93eedd8`, the pin llm-mailroom v0.30.0 declares) plus #158 (review-tray correction rate, MAUD
ambiguous-question precision, money ledger). **Production slim-down:** the analysis, export,
grid, visualization and sync surfaces are removed (`analysis/{error_analysis,export,grid,
interpret,io,report,visualize}`, `cli.py` and the `dojo-*` CLIs, `integrations/{langfuse,
phoenix}_sync`, `pipeline/sandbox_{agent_scoring,composite}`, `scoring/rescore`); no sandbox code
imported them. Added: one document-class registry (`schemas/doc_classes.py`), decision-lane
scorecards, the `ml/` contract, and prompt/schema alignment with contracts and merger production
v2 prompts (the pipeline still serves frozen v1). **Score changes** against v0.29.0: merger MAUD
gold and ambiguous-question precision, field-micro on Hub rows and `pending_annotation` fields,
money strings with K/M/B suffixes, and the insurance `carrier` field. Compare runs scored on
different Dojo pins only after rescoring; each ladder pair runs on one pin.

Before that: `v0.29.0` (`f95c3188a1a634a9a2354afd5351edd8dd152a89`, package version 0.28.1),
llm-dojo-scoring #135: date scoring hardening. Yearless labels cap a
dated prediction at 0.67, an unverified year never pairs as a list or audit date match,
two-digit years use a fixed pivot, weekday names never supply a day, and a date fragment earns
no name credit. Date-field scores can move against v0.28.1 runs; compare like with like.

Before that: `v0.28.1` (`00a2a7f7b058a4ade06b027c2afbd8b03bea6a5f`).

Dojo release `v0.28.1`. v0.28.0 aligns with mailroom-dataset v10: corporate schema v2
(new registered fields such as party roles, signatories, agreement and expiration dates,
termination notice and dispute forum) and the v10 row schemas (`schemas/v10_rows.py`).
v0.28.1 changes the sorter guide: a bylaw amendment is `bylaws`, never `board_resolution`
(corpus rule C); v9.3 labels 8 such amendments `board_resolution`, so scoring against v9.3
counts those 8 as wrong until v10 relabels them.

Changes originate in the authoritative standalone repository, are committed and
reviewed there, then consumed here. Never patch this snapshot or export hub
changes back into the owning repository. After importing the same revisions,
the Digital-Mailroom workspace and these generated snapshots must match.

Dojo owns scoring; llm-mailroom owns the pipeline. Production corporate v6
and sandbox evaluation v7 remain separate intentional prompt catalogs.

Previous pin: llm-dojo-scoring `main` at `b3ec0fba` (Dojo PR #123), on top of the 0.27.2 release.
#123 fixes review findings on the 0.27.2 vendor bump (llm-mailroom#164): prose-wrapped JSON
with many failing candidate objects parses in linear time (each candidate is decoded from
its own balanced slice), and `rescore_record` picks an already-current record's headline by
the same task routing a fresh rescore uses. #122 changes Dojo's release scripts only. The
package version is still `0.27.2`; return the pin to a release tag once v0.27.3 is cut.

Previously: llm-dojo-scoring 0.27.2, the squash merge `1cd4aba7` of Dojo PR #121. 0.27.2 fixes
the review findings on the 0.27.1 snapshot (local-mailroom-sandbox#245): `score_document`
never raises on deeply nested prediction text and parses brace-heavy text in linear time;
any `Mapping` prediction is a dict payload for adherence; a prose-wrapped Python repr sets
`prose_wrapper`; `rescore` reports `headline_score` for CUAD/MAUD rows. No field-map, tier 0
or headline score changes. The pin names the `v0.27.2` tag and verifies its SHA.

It builds on 0.27.1, the commit `a82843e8` of Dojo PR #118 (tag `v0.27.1`).
0.27.0 added tiered per-document-type scoring (`score_document`, new `score_archive_block`
keys for the llm-mailroom unified audit row); 0.27.1 makes `score_document` and
`score_archive_block` never raise on bad field values, derives the CMS `cms_source_table`
from `doc_subclass`, and guards the new block keys. Field-map scores are unchanged except
CMS insurance rows scored with `doc_subclass` and no `expected_subclass`.
It supersedes the v0.26.0 snapshot (`2fea5ea7`) and, here, the v0.27.1 snapshot (`a82843e8`).

Previously: llm-dojo-scoring 0.26.0, the release merge commit `2fea5ea7` of Dojo PR #112
